name: research-assistant-suite-chatgpt
description: One-entry research workflow that combines methodological planning with evidence-traceable literature search in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Connect study design with traceable evidence.
interface.longDescription: A single-entry research workflow that frames a scientific study, delegates targeted scholarly evidence work, and returns an evidence-aware next-step decision. It keeps methodology and source-search ownership separate and does not invent citations or results.
defaultPrompt: Find evidence for my study question and recommend the next step.
Turn this research idea into a literature-backed study plan.
Compare methods in the literature for my experiment.
